reviews.text: We are so excited about the beautiful new patio cover we had installed this week by Affordable Aluminum. We just love it! Our installers , the Lead on the job Nathan and his tech Brent did such a great job. They were so polite, friendly, and hard workers. We appreciated their attention to detail and how meticulous they were with their cleanup.. Thank you for replacing our old leaky wood patio cover.

A Affordable Aluminum is the pool enclosure company owned by Jimmie and Terri Silvers that was recommended by a friend after we visited her home and saw the pool enclosure this company installed. About a year later we hired a totally different company to build our covered patio and pool enclosure and after some serious issues with this initial company, owner, we parted ways with him. Unbeknownst to us, this owner had hired A Affordable Aluminum Company so they were  in fact the ones who had alre

What a fantastic experience!! It all started with me reaching out to multiple contractors for a backyard screen enclosure back in August 2021 and now having an amazing backyard thanks to A Affordable Aluminum. While my first impression of Jimmy (the owner) was a bit rough, he offered me the best contract. While it took almost 7 months before they started work, the Project management and working crew were exceptional. I received prompt updates to my requests from Terri (Project manager) and thril

My husband and I lost our much-loved screened porch in May 2024 when a tree fell on it in a storm. A Affordable Aluminum was the original builder of said porch, and was our first choice for the rebuild. They did an excellent job of bringing it back to life, and we couldn’t be happier! We greatly appreciate the job they did!

Affordable Aluminum did an A+ Job on the outdoor screen room in our patio. They were very professional right from the quote submission to the actual project completion in 2021. Post that they have been extremely responsive even when we had some minor issues. Top notch customer service and will recommend them in a heartbeat

We're very happy with the pool enclosure that A Affordable Aluminum built for us. What a great feeling to relax in the backyard, by the pool with the sound of the birds, the fragrant of flowers without irritation of bugs, dirt.

I highly recommend A Affordable Aluminum for all of your screened enclosure needs. I requested a quote over the phone, sent pictures and answered their questions. I got a quote within the same day. I thought it was high because of the hurricane so I got another estimate. Not only were they actually cheaper than the second bid, they were able to fit me in two months earlier than the other bid. Not only that, they told me it would be 2-3 weeks and they were within 2 weeks. They had a fabulous tech

After losing our awesome screened in porch/pool after hurricane Beryl, we asked around and AAffordable Aluminum was recommended - hands down!! Everyone from first call to inquire to finished project was wonderful. Customer service at it's best! Amazing quality, timing, pricing, respectful and trustworthy from the office to our installer, Memo!! You won't go wrong with AAffordable Aluminum!

affordable Aluminum is a great company to do business with.   They responded quickly after my call of damaged screens over my pool.  Also, their work is very good.
Also, their office staff is very courteous.
James Kyle

Our screened in patio is absolutely beautiful! We love it, but most of all, our cats love it! This has given us a safe outdoor space to enjoy with our furbabies that is mosquito free. The whole experience was pleasant and the workers were fantastic! I actually enjoyed having them here at my home. Thank you to all!

We are very pleased with the new aluminum pergola installed mid-December. The crew worked professionally, were courteous and cleaned up after the job was done. Jimmy, Terri and Jessica at the shop guided us through the process from concept, material selection, scheduling and installation. We highly recommend AAffordable Aluminum for your pergola project.

Our 400 sq ft custom pergola is now 3 years old and it looks and performs like brand new. Not a loose bolt or hint of chipped paint. Very smooth process from measure to design to install. Highly recommend.

Affordable Aluminum installed our pool screen enclosure years back and when I called last week needing replacement parts (hinges and a lock) they quickly put me on the schedule and, not only did they provide the parts free of charge, they also included the labor.  Very impressed with their customer service and the quality of their work!

We love our new screened room!  From the very beginning we were pleased with the friendly and helpful people at Affordable Aluminum.  I can't say enough about the professional way things were completed.  Right from beginning to end.  You could tell that the installers were very experienced and they made sure the project was done right the first time.  This is uncommon for many contractors and so we definitely would recommend this group for installing your enclosure.

We were absolutely please with the screen enclosure A Affordable Aluminum build for our pool.  They were at the job sight when they said they would be.  Their workers were friendly and personable, but always working.  We enjoyed having them here.  When they were done they cleaned up after themselves, and left the job in good condition.  I highly recommend this company.

Awesome!! Jimmy has been a great help in the design. It's way more than we had expected. His crew was the best and Moses is one BA framer. I would recommend Affordable Aluminum to anyone wanting to build a screen enclosure. Keep it up Jimmy you guys are top notch!!

Jerry & Gretchen
Inez, TX

Jimmy’s crew did a great job on replacing my dads screen door on his pool enclosure. Now we have a kid-safe door and don’t have to worry about them getting access to the pool without us. Great family run business!

We contacted A Affordable Aluminum after looking at several of their installations and also after a few referrals. We were not disappointed! After the initial consultation we decided that this was the company to do our screened enclosure upon completion of our inground pool. From start to finish, every team member was polite, courteous and very knowledgeable of their product and they even beat the estimated completion time by 2 days. They have  got it down to a tee. Call them and I guarantee you

A Affordable Aluminum screened in my patio July 2-3, 2015. They arrive promptly and was vey considered and polite during the whole installation. They were quick to answer any questions that I asked. They did a very good job and when they had finished and left my neighbors commented on how they liked it. I will definitely refer this company to family and friends.

Virginia J.

We’ve had our porch and patio screened in now for several years. The product really sells itself. It’s held up thru several storms including Harvey. Jimmie said it would hold up and it has without question.
The main reason I went with A Affordable was b/c Jimmie gave me a rough quote over the phone and was willing to have a conversation in which most companies wanted me to fill out something online and they would be in contact. The way he conducted business is a lost art form compared to most ot

Amazing quality, timing, pricing, respectful and trustworthy from the office to our installer, Memo!! You won't go wrong with AAffordable Aluminum!
reviews.author: Jennifer Lamden

data.summary: The reviews for A Affordable Aluminum appear overwhelmingly authentic and reflect a high-quality contractor. The content is detailed, varied, and credible, describing specific projects and personnel. The primary concern is the duplication of several reviews verbatim between the company's two Google Maps listings, which is a minor red flag for platform behavior but does not undermine the authenticity of the customer experiences described. No significant complaint patterns or warranty issues are evident.
fake_signals: Identical review text appears on both Google Maps profiles (Local and HQ) for several reviews, suggesting potential duplication or platform manipulation.

positive_evidence: 'Post that they have been extremely responsive even when we had some minor issues'
'A Affordable Aluminum was the original builder of said porch, and was our first choice for the rebuild.'

authentic_signals: Reviews contain highly specific details: project types (pool enclosures, patio covers, storm damage rebuilds), crew names (Nathan, Brent, Memo, Terri), timelines (August 2021, May 2024, Hurricane Beryl), and outcomes.
Writing styles are varied and personal, with specific emotional reactions and project narratives.
Reviews mention both positive experiences and minor critiques (long wait, initial owner impression), adding credibility.
Multiple reviews reference being a repeat customer or a rebuild after storm damage, indicating established relationships.
complaint_patterns: Initial impression of owner described as 'rough'
data.discrepancy_explanation: Ratings are highly consistent across Google and Yelp, both showing excellent scores. No BBB profile found is not inherently suspicious for a smaller contractor.
